headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 4, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels fell to the Baltimore Orioles 3-1, with Tyler O'Neill hitting a solo home run for the Orioles. The New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, led by Luis Torrens' 3-hit, 4-RBI performance. The Cincinnati Reds edged the Athletics 5-4 in a closely contested matchup.

Injuries and availability are impacting several teams. The Washington Nationals placed right fielder James Wood on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The Athletics also have multiple players on the injured list, including Jeffrey Springs (right hip discomfort) and Nick Kurtz (strained right thumb).

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Athletics acquired RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels dropped a 3-1 decision to the Baltimore Orioles in their latest matchup. Tyler O'Neill led the Orioles' offense with a solo home run, his eighth of the season.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians 6-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 6.0 innings pitched. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Athletics in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 5-4 victory over the Athletics in a closely contested matchup. Julian Garcia earned the win for the Reds, while Emilio Pagán recorded the save.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Phillies in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals were defeated by the Philadelphia Phillies with a final score of 5-0. Jesús Luzardo earned the win for the Phillies, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals' James Wood Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals right fielder James Wood has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Seth Johnson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics on August 3, 2026, in exchange for RF Colby Thomas.
